WCE retain Perth Stadium HGA support but their ODELO at Optus is a near-neutral +0.2 — they barely outperform their terrible season baseline at home. Key EV is the TOTAL UNDER — both teams are averaging well under 70pts in recent weeks yet the bookmaker total sits at 183.5.
